messages:
Rina: someone else crying at the tiny fireflies animation during the closing slide or is it just me? :sparkles: :sob:
Marco: not just you. also lowkey want that animation as my wallpaper now :pray:
Sasha: petition to replace the hold music in the SF lobby with that gentle twinkle loop :raised_hands:
Evan: @Sasha, yes. also major props to infra for zero hiccups during the demo :clap:
Pri: did anyone catch the fortune cookie line at the end? 'Your cache will always be warm' brilliant :joy:
Rina: okay poll: post-all-hands treat — fortune cookies (yes/no) or bring-your-own snack? reply with "fortune", "bring", or "none"
Marco: fortune
Sasha: bring (i will provide artisanal chips)
Evan: fortune, obviously. must know my cryptic cache fate
Pri: none for me, commuting from the suburbs tonight :train:
allhands-bot: Recording & slides are up: https://redwood.example/ah/1761234567 (auto-post)
Rina: also who recorded the awkward but wholesome high-five between @Marco and @Pri? need that clip for the meme channel
memebot: uploaded "highfive_slowmo.mp4" to thread (link) :laughing:
Marco: guilty. my high-five was both athletic and deeply emotional
Sasha: logistics check: SF folks going to the rooftop after? 6:30?
Evan: i'll be there, bringing a small Bluetooth speaker and my questionable playlist
Pri: depends if there are fortune cookies. if yes, i'm in for collecting my destiny
Rina: quick aside: shoutout to design for the new slide fonts. clean and readable at 9am and 7pm :sparkles:
Marco: shoutout to the intern who improvised the surprise ukulele outro, iconic energy :guitar:
Sasha: i volunteer to judge the 'best tiny ukulele face' at the rooftop meetup :medal:
Evan: tally so far: fortune 2, bring 1, none 1  fortune wins!
Rina: wonderful. i'll pick up a pack of whimsical fortune cookies and maybe some tea
memebot: posted "fireflies_loop.gif" to thread (link) :heart_eyes:
Pri: FYI office plants in the lobby need watering tomorrow, if anyone is in early pls ping #office-help
Marco: i'll water them on my way in, tiny plant dad duties accepted :seedling:
Sasha: @Rina please clip the ukulele outro + fireflies and post in #memes, ancient internet must see this
Rina: will do. see you all on the rooftop at 6:30. bring warmth, snacks, and your best tiny-ukulele-face
allhands-bot: Feedback survey reminder: 2 hours left to submit. Thanks for the vibes! :sparkles:
